[operation: user-find]



READ-ONLY



Searches users by free-text query matched against email and name (partial matches supported). Paginated.

- query (req): partial email or name

- page (opt), pageSize (opt, default 200)

→ paginated list of users, each with: {id, name, email, isSuperAdmin, licenses, workspaces, salesforce (opt), hubspot (opt), slug (opt), managedWorkspaces, managedTeams}

see: user-read (full profile), user-find-by-ids (batch by ID), user-find-by-filter (advanced multi-fiel

[operation: user-read]



READ-ONLY



Fetches full profile for a single user by userId.

- userId (req): UUID

→

    {id, name, email, isSuperAdmin, licenses, workspaces (set of workspaceIds), salesforce: {email, id} (opt), hubspot: {email, id} (opt), slug (opt), managedWorkspaces, managedTeams}

  Note: top-level field is id (not userId); workspaces (not workspaceMemberships); salesforce is an object {email, id} (not a string salesforceId)

[operation: user-find-by-ids]



READ-ONLY



Batch-fetches full profiles for a known set of userIds in one request — the id-list counterpart to user-read. The body is a bare JSON array of userId UUIDs (e.g. ["uuid1", "uuid2"]), not wrapped in an object.

→ paginated list of users, each with: {id, name, email, isSuperAdmin, licenses, workspaces, salesforce: {email, id} (opt), hubspot: {email, id} (opt), slug (opt), managedWorkspaces, managedTeams}

see: user-find/find-by-filter (look up userIds)

[operation: user-update-licenses]



MUTATING — IDEMPOTENT



Bulk-updates CP product licenses for one or more users. Unlisted users are unaffected.

- update (req): [{userId, licenseType}]; valid types: Distro, ChiliCalOrg, Concierge, ConciergeLive, Chat, Handoff; use user-find for userIds

→

    {}

⚠ downgrade takes effect immediately (disables gated features); fails if org lacks sufficient seats

see: user-find/find-by-ids (resolve userIds and verify after)
